Hypoxia → motility, encoded as a cell-behavior grammar

The verbatim PhysiCell hypoxia rules, executed by the generic GrammarRulesProcess on a minimal oxygen-field + point-agent reference substrate. Low oxygen drives a transition to a motile phenotype that disseminates from the hypoxic core and reverts on reoxygenation — the paper's transient post-hypoxic migration.
